# snowHeads

> > snowHeads is the UK's largest online ski and snowboard community forum, featuring real-time snow reports, resort discussions, and winter sports advice.

Operating as 'Ski Club 2.0', snowHeads is a phpBB-powered community platform where skiers and snowboarders share trip reports, snow conditions, equipment advice, and discuss everything from on-piste skiing to off-piste adventures across global ski resorts.

## Main Forum

- [Ski Club 2.0 , snowHeads ski forum](https://snowheads.com): Homepage for snowHeads Ski Club 2.0 forum and UK snow sports community
- [Ski Club 2.0, real snow reports!, snowHeads ski forum](https://snowheads.com/ski-forum): Main ski forum index for snowHeads community discussions and reports
- [Ski Club 2.0, real snow reports!, snowHeads ski forum](https://snowheads.com/ski-forum/index.php): Forum index with ski resort discussions and trip reports

## Snow Reports & Conditions

- [Snow Reports - weather - snow conditions, snowHeads ski forum](https://snowheads.com/ski-forum/snow_reports.php): Community-submitted snow reports and weather conditions for ski resorts
